title: Flood Survival Guide
content: Do not walk, swim, or drive through flood waters. Turn Around, Don't Drown! Just six inches of fast-moving water can knock you over, and twelve inches can carry away a small car. If your vehicle is trapped in rapidly moving water, stay inside. If water rises inside the vehicle, seek refuge on the roof. Move to higher ground immediately when a flood warning is issued. Disconnect electrical appliances and do not touch electrical equipment if you are wet or standing in water.
